title: Solve and verify simultaneous equations
subject: Pure Mathematics
question: Solve the simultaneous equations x + y = 7 and x - y = 1. Show your working and verify your values by substituting them into both original equations.

guide.text: Adds the two equations correctly to eliminate y: 2x = 8 (or an equivalent valid elimination step).
Substitutes x = 4 and obtains y = 3 correctly.
Verifies x = 4 and y = 3 in x + y = 7 and obtains 7.
Verifies x = 4 and y = 3 in x - y = 1 and obtains 1.

rules: Award M1 only when an actual elimination step is written. If a valid alternative method obtains both values, award A1 and A2 but not M1 unless elimination is shown. Do not award verification marks unless the substitutions and resulting equalities are written. A final pair with no working can earn A1 and A2 only if both values are correct.
